invariants.text: 租户边界覆盖数据库 RLS、运行时上下文、事件、缓存和外部连接器。
经营事件、审批和关键回执只增不改；纠正通过新事件表达，不静默覆盖证据。
所有外部或变更性动作及其子调用，统一经过权限、PII、围栏和审批链路。
涉钱、敏感数据、群发、公开发布、交易和破坏性变更必须按高风险处理并由人审批。
没有真实回执就不能标记完成；mock、模拟和体验模式在数据结构与界面上都要明确区分。
客户原始经营数据不得上行；蜂群只接受白名单化、最小化、匿名化且可审计的元数据或派生经验。
租户覆盖层只能收紧围栏，不能放宽平台不可变红线。
模型、提示词、技能、bundle、策略和热更新必须先评测再灰度，且始终可回滚。
platform-ops、平台账户运营和平台秘密只属于 Andromeda。
Tiger 在获得单独的合规审查和用户明确授权前，只能模拟或纸面交易。
令牌、密码、API key、私钥、客户凭证和私密客户数据不得进入源码、文档、上下文、提示词、日志或提交。
个性化与行业扩展不得形成公共机制的第二事实源。

cards.title: Conflicting model fields can be selected again through identity and alias leaves

evidence.note: Five source-only counterexamples at 98b: three failed; live VID1007 original support judge rejected the selected identity model.

cards.trigger_path: A1 extractor selects /model while the same model parameters are in blockedFields; only the later semantic judge rejects the contradiction.

assertions.given: Conflict model parameters, identity/alias/variant copies, safe non-model clauses, unambiguous model and one extractor response
assertions.expect: Conflicting optional model copies are unavailable before support review; safe independent claims remain source-bound; no source bytes change and a denied extraction makes one model call.

cards.fix_plan: Propagate conservative model-field restrictions to identity/variant/model aliases and instruct native extraction to omit optional ambiguous claims. Do not rewrite source facts or change judge outcomes.
cards.blast_radius: Controlled archive claim selection only. Existing provenance, one-shot judge, final qualification and customer original files retained.
cards.rollback: Revert this policy extension; retain denied VID1007 and all source archives; never resubmit media automatically.
cards.notes: P2 prospective claim restriction. Live semantic support judge already rejected this input; no observed media or unsupported film was accepted.
